name: Pied wagtail
lateFeature: Bold black-and-white layered wing feathers and long clean tail shafts
anatomyNotes: Right-facing Pied wagtail in a walking stance, very long thin tail projecting left and two separated long dark legs. Paint the tail as narrow deliberate pulls; the large black bib and white cheek edges sharpen later. Branch mounting needs a sufficiently wide nearly level perch to support both feet naturally.
